title: Исход 34 — Exodus 34
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Утром приготовься и поднимись на ___ Синай.
cases.translation: In the morning be ready and go up to Mount Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition на with motion (up onto) takes the accusative → гору.

cases.sentence: Господь спустился в ___, встал рядом с ним и возвестил имя Господа.
cases.translation: The Lord came down in the cloud, stood there with him, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" (location, no motion) takes the prepositional → облаке.
The preposition перед (in front of) takes the instrumental → Моисеем.

cases.sentence: За проступки ___ он карает детей и внуков.
cases.translation: For the sins of the fathers he punishes the children and grandchildren.
cases.explain: Possession ("the sins of the fathers") is expressed by the genitive plural → отцов.

cases.sentence: …прости нам проступки и ___ и возьми нас себе в удел.
cases.translation: …forgive us our transgressions and sins and take us as your inheritance.
cases.explain: Грехи is the direct object of прости (forgive); for this inanimate masculine plural the accusative equals the nominative → грехи.
The verb поклоняться (to worship / bow to) governs the dative → богу.

cases.sentence: Разрушьте их жертвенники, разбейте священные ___ и срубите столбы Ашеры.
cases.translation: Tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and cut down the Asherah poles.
cases.explain: Камни is the direct object of разбейте (smash); for this inanimate masculine plural the accusative equals the nominative → камни.

cases.sentence: …потому что в этом ___ вы вышли из Египта.
cases.translation: …because in this month you came out of Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a time period takes the prepositional → месяце.

reading.ru: Господь сказал Моисею, «Высеки две каменные плитки, подобные прежним, а я напишу на них слова, что были на первых плитках, которые ты разбил.
reading.question: What was Moses told to chisel?
options: Two stone tablets like the first ones
reading.correct: Two stone tablets like the first ones
reading.explain: The Lord told Moses to chisel two stone tablets like the first, on which He would write the words.

reading.ru: Господь спустился в облаке, встал рядом с ним и возвестил имя Господа.
reading.question: How did the Lord descend to Moses?
reading.explain: The Lord came down in a cloud, stood with him, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.

reading.ru: Моисей пробыл там с Господом сорок дней и сорок ночей.
reading.question: How long did Moses remain there with the Lord?
reading.explain: Moses stayed there with the Lord forty days and forty nights.

reading.ru: Он ничего не ел и не пил, он написал на плитках слова Завета десять заповедей.
reading.question: What did Moses write on the tablets?
options: The words of the covenant, the ten commandments
reading.correct: The words of the covenant, the ten commandments
reading.explain: Moses wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

reading.ru: Спустившись с горы Синай, с двумя каменными плитками свидетельства в руках, Моисей не знал, что его лицо сияет после того, как он поговорил с Господом.
reading.question: What did Moses not realize as he came down from Sinai?
reading.explain: Coming down from Sinai, Moses did not know that his face shone after speaking with the Lord.

reading.ru: Закончив говорить с ними, Моисей опустил на лицо покрывало.
reading.question: What did Moses put on his face after speaking to the people?
reading.explain: When Moses finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
